answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in forge, expire in anchor, and thread lists each expiry. An farming party running 187 aliases as a result needs 24 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1867 identities would post 816 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
